subject: Add note-decay disable switch for bench eval (gate subsumption + decay) + verify conv-26 has zero subsumption events
description:
Make bench eval runs immune to note-decay so memory can't mutate mid-measurement (deterministic numbers). Root finding: subsumption (lib/judge.js findSubsumedNotes, called at note-write in routes/overlay.js ~627) retires older near-dup notes (cosine ≥0.92) — empirically confirmed (dozens of {"actor":"subsumption"} note_superseded events in the bench workspaces). #35's skip-re-ingest guard already prevents the duplicate that triggers it; this adds a hard off-switch as defense + determinism.

CHANGES:
1. Daemon env flag, e.g. `ORCH_DISABLE_NOTE_DECAY=1`: when set, the daemon SKIPS (a) the subsumption call in routes/overlay.js (the findSubsumedNotes / note_superseded path) and (b) the decay slow-lane / reinforce passes (lib/judge.js + the decay drain). Default OFF — production behavior UNCHANGED when the flag is absent (verify the flag-off path is byte-identical in effect). This touches production daemon code, so be surgical and keep the default path intact.
2. The embedded bench daemon (bench/zonoid_bench/daemon.py spawn env) sets `ORCH_DISABLE_NOTE_DECAY=1`, so every bench run is decay-free.

VERIFY (one conv, bounded foreground, NO long run / NO poll): re-run conv-26 our-way against an embedded daemon with the flag set, and confirm: (a) ZERO new `"actor":"subsumption"` events written to the workspace, (b) retrieval still populated (context_keys non-empty), (c) ≥1 probe answered correctly. Report before/after. Flat task off main. Embedded daemon ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS=0; per claude -p ≤120s. Honesty bar: gold never in retrieve/keep/answer.
